headline: Another empty news day; lines drift as stories fade
body: Another quiet day with no scored events. The same slow fade of earlier news continued, shaving a few hundredths off Protector God, Descendants and Enslaved God and adding a little to 1984 and Reversion. With no fresh news, the picture is essentially unchanged from yesterday. Horizon Balance: +2.18.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Descendants -0.05.
